scope: Fixed-hardware, source-informed simulation; numerical engineering hypotheses are not manufacturer measurements. No parameter is selected using policy outcomes.

protected_decisions.ledger_owner: root; this file does not reserve or charge any run

hardware_identity.raw_source: Sonardyne SMART Type 8316 family; one six-axis logger per collection site, not one full SMART per small BSN
hardware_identity.optical: BlueComm 200 UV Type 8361: gateway emitter and AUV receiver only
hardware_identity.acoustic: Sonardyne Wideband 2 MF-compatible endpoint service abstraction; exact installed endpoint electronics and waveform not calibrated
hardware_identity.cable: Dedicated 500-m vertical service per site; numerical serial-service abstraction, not a qualified SMART-native 500-m RS-485 interface
hardware_identity.integration: SMART/BlueComm family compatibility is documented; the complete elevated-gateway/vehicle assembly is an engineering study configuration

candidate_grid.mapping: reviewedMaxAttempts = retries + 1; lifetime per acoustic leg, never reset by contact/cycle

workload.release_rule: Only complete acquisitions with release_s <91798.03; do not stop generation at the mature-cohort cutoff.
workload.high_medium_streams: seed*1009+101 and seed*1009+307, preserved independent streams; rotate through BSN IDs
workload.low_source: separate finite logger archive, then real dedicated cable; not instantaneous LOW generation at elevated gateway
workload.metric: LOW success requires every chunk of the same complete window at the endpoint before oldest_sample_time+30000; missing chunks stay in denominator
workload.maturity: per-class source creation or oldest sample time + class deadline <= fixed observation horizon
workload.finite_cohort_warning: A steady offered rate exceeding6000 bps proves lack of indefinite sustainability, not impossibility of95% success in the finite mature cohort; terminal backlog is separately mandatory.

wire_contract.control_kind1: Encoded causal telemetry,29-byte report header plus42 per complete window and4 per chunk
wire_contract.lower_layers: Frozen ns-3 MAC/routing/PHY framing adds its own measured serialized cost. User-rate scale is not an exact manufacturer net-throughput claim.
wire_contract.control: Best effort, real encoded body, bounded separate source and receiver state, no implicit ACK or retry; optional emitter PHY-completion callback absent.
wire_contract.ack_timing: Actual local DATA-fragment PHY outcomes anchor the timer;12 s is explicit post-local-completion queue/processing grace, not a universal contention-delay bound. Silent lower-MAC stalls use the hard record lifetime.

documented_service_rate_options_not_extr.scope: Options are documented user-service scales, not three already executed experiments or permission to add a factorial campaign. Nominal remains6000; any additional run must fit an explicitly reserved approved phase. None reproduces the commercial MF waveform.

documented_selected_facts.source: HARDWARE_CONTRACT and manufacturer audits with original primary links

values: original180-position12600-m geometry15 surface nodes8 collection sites

acoustic_idle_w.meaning: quiescent-power upper-envelope engineering proxy, not an exact measured receive-listening specification

acoustic_sleep_w.meaning: explicit unused-sleep-state hypothesis; default operating policy stays awake

small_bsn_budget_wh.meaning: finite installed-budget hypothesis, not the full SMART battery or certified small-sensor autonomy

relay_gateway_surface_budget_wh_each.meaning: finite per-owner study budget; no extra budget appears upon recharge/contact

logger_usable_fraction_of_1500wh.meaning: engineering derating, not a measured battery discharge curve

vehicle_baseline_w.meaning: non-study-interface baseline hypothesis inside the published whole-vehicle endurance scale; extra acoustic/optical loads charged once to shared battery, not added to an already-complete measured total

non_radio_baselines_w.meaning: explicit electronics hypotheses, no duplication of separate SMART logging

link_hypotheses_not_vendor_guarantees.acoustic: 27-kHz absorption proxy,60-dB link-margin profile,300/1000-m fixed service gates,512-B fragments and modeled ALOHA are engineering abstractions. No100-dB QA margin and no automatic reachability enlargement.
link_hypotheses_not_vendor_guarantees.cable: 9600-bit/s dedicated service with10 bits/byte,500m/2e8m/s propagation,10-ms durable-admission delay,1-ms turnaround and explicit cable powers. No qualification of a native product cable or real flash latency is implied.
link_hypotheses_not_vendor_guarantees.optical: Root proposed before outcomes:1-s startup30-s session5-s polling0.9 DC efficiency,30/10-W startup proxy,1% of a second turnaround,1-s control prediction,12-s actual acoustic ACK wait,3 attempts,4096 receipt slots and8-MiB credit. Nominal pFrame=1 is an optimistic error-free inside-contact service case, not a calibrated405-nm attenuation/pointing model.

parameter_classification.software_allocations: 1-GiB logger archive allocation is below32-GB documented storage;64-KiB source and gateway staging plus16-MiB outbox/carry are proposed allocations, not manufacturer RAM. Control source and receiver slots, receipt cache and planner state must be deducted from finite application allocations; C++ simulator RSS is not claimed as MCU RAM.
parameter_classification.mission_hypotheses: 10-minute external recovery allowance540kJ at900W,60-s regular and600-s terminal service allowances rounded by the fixed3-kn100-m-turn-radius route implementation,30000-s revisit bound,300-s telemetry period1200-s maximum age. These are predeclared operating choices, not measured HUGIN manoeuvre/latency guarantees.

load.meaning: Double HIGH/MED event rates, raw acquisition unchanged; generator must implement this explicitly.

long.meaning: Longer deployment at original spatial densities; fixed91798.03-s horizon explicitly accepted by root before results, unlike the old five-cycle179596.06-s long experiment. Do not silently mix these cohorts.

sparse.meaning: Same generated records, no new acoustic range or surface endpoint.

memory1mb.meaning: Decimal1MB resident outbox, not100 records or1MiB.

perturbed.meaning: Predeclared stochastic whole-optical-DATA failure inside contact; same attempts and state costs. Not a simulated missed visit or measured UV channel.

phase_recipes.interpretation: Five transfer seeds per recipe;15 mechanism runs and10 immediate-fallback runs. FIFO changes gateway eviction only, not service priority. The15-run immediate phase is a ceiling, not a required target. Selected nominal candidate parameters are frozen before these tests; these outcomes never reselect candidates.

artifact_bindings_required_per_run.workloadReplayCsv: Actual pre-generated matched context/seed CSV with recorded SHA256; no placeholder path may reach simulator.
artifact_bindings_required_per_run.RngRun: Exact integer from the predeclared phase seed list.
artifact_bindings_required_per_run.mediumFallbackTimeout: Hybrid candidate60 or120; explicit unused value120 for D-P.
artifact_bindings_required_per_run.mediumFallbackRefillRate: Hybrid candidate0.015/0.02/0.03; explicit unused0 for D-P.
artifact_bindings_required_per_run.binary_identity: Compiled immutable source+all included headers+binary hash, linked to a successful component receipt; the existence of this JSON is not that receipt.

mandatory_before_any_scientific_launch: Root review of numerical hypotheses; the common91798.03-s long-context horizon was explicitly accepted before results. No new author decision is inferred unless the architecture/service scope changes.
Compile all current integrations and preserve exact test markers/counts;58 reviewed/control checks are expected but not yet claimed passed at drafting.
Actual reserved integration QA must demonstrate encoded controls and metadata without false receiver knowledge, ACK confirmation, finite ownership and complete energy; retain failures.
Executable driver merges each family/context/candidate exactly, detects duplicate/unrecognized CLI flags and hashes replay before execution.
Verify source energy is not duplicated at its bottom relay, optical load not duplicated with vehicle baseline, and undeployed D-P AUV has zero physical energy.

Confirm finite application allocations account for control send/receive/planner/receipt states; generic source expiry is not a claim that the lower MAC queue itself has a fully proved finite-memory bound.

Audit remaining acoustic abstraction assumptions including PHY arrival/loss/collision accounting and post-local-completion ACK grace; fullphysical gate must not be enabled merely to run this candidate.
Fresh machine preflight:2CPU,6GiB,at least4GiB free to start,stop below1.5GB,thermal warning checks,maximum400 total network runs and20QA ledger limit.

reporting.selection: Use only all195 nominal tuning runs; physical validity on every seed and mean mature-cohort miss fractions<=0.01HIGH,<=0.05MED,<=0.05completeLOWwindows. Then minimize immersed energy, fullmission energy, candidateID; no reselection on confirmation/transfer.
reporting.infeasible: If no candidate meets service and physical constraints, report infeasibility; do not relax limits or silently improve hardware.
reporting.energy: Primary energy from authoritative finite per-owner PHY/state/source/mission ledgers. Failed transmissions, ACKs, overhearing, startup, waiting, carry/return/recovery are included. Legacy DATA-only energy is diagnostic.
reporting.all_outcomes: Publish mature service and terminal backlog together, receiver receipt distinct from sender confirmation, raw windows distinct from chunks, full mission energy separate from submerged communication savings. No optimality outside evaluated candidates/catalogue.
